name: CET-4 核心词
description: 大学英语四级核心词汇

example.en: We have a problem.
example.cn: 我们遇到了一个麻烦。

translations.meaning: 离弃，丢弃；遗弃，抛弃；放弃

example.en: How could she abandon her own child?
example.cn: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子呢？

example.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
example.cn: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

example.en: one of my more able students
example.cn: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

example.en: abnormal behaviour
example.cn: 反常行为

example.en: The plane crashed, killing all 200 people aboard.
example.cn: 飞机失事，机上200人全部遇难。

example.en: a book about politics
example.cn: 一本有关政治的书

example.en: He lived in a flat above the shop.
example.cn: 他住在那商店上面的一套房间里。

example.en: I’ve never lived abroad before.
example.cn: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

example.en: The path ends off abruptly.
example.cn: 这条路突然到头了。

example.en: In the absence of any evidence, the police had to let Myers go.
example.cn: 警察没有证据，只好把迈尔斯放了。

example.en: The dull, absent look on her face implied boredom.
example.cn: 她脸上呆滞、茫然的神情说明她觉得无聊了。

example.en: Some of the stuff on TV is absolute rubbish.
example.cn: 电视上播放的有些东西简直就是垃圾。

example.en: He made his reasons for resigning absolutely clear.
example.cn: 他把辞职的理由讲得一清二楚。

example.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
example.cn: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

translations.meaning: 摘要， 梗概； 抽象派艺术作品

example.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
example.cn: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

example.en: an abundant supply of fresh water
example.cn: 充足的淡水供应

example.en: Williams abused his position as Mayor to give jobs to his friends.
example.cn: 威廉斯滥用市长权力，给不少朋友安排了工作。

example.en: He possessed no academic qualifications.
example.cn: 他没有学历。

example.en: a military academy
example.cn: 军事学院

example.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
example.cn: 加快经济增长速度的措施

example.en: The latest model has excellent acceleration.
example.cn: 这款最新型号加速性能优异。

example.en: He had a strong Irish accent
example.cn: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

example.en: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
example.cn: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

example.en: Students who achieve an acceptable standard will progress to degree studies.
example.cn: 达到一定程度的学生可以进一步攻读学位。

example.en: He wrote a letter of acceptance (= a letter in which you agree to accept a job, university place etc ) to the university.
example.cn: 他给那所大学写了一封接受函。

translations.meaning: 接近；通道，入口；接近的机会

example.en: Access is by means of a small door on the right.
example.cn: 入口是右边的一扇小门。

example.en: an accessary to murder
example.cn: 谋杀案的帮凶

example.en: The island is only accessible by boat.
example.cn: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

example.en: Over 70,000 people are seriously injured every year in road accidents.
example.cn: 每年在道路事故中受重伤的有七万多人。

example.en: an accidental discharge of toxic waste
example.cn: 有毒废料的意外排放

example.en: He bought a huge house to accommodate his library.
example.cn: 他买了一座大房子来放他的藏书。

example.en: The price for the holiday includes flights and accommodation.
example.cn: 度假的价格包括机票和住宿。

example.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
example.cn: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

example.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
example.cn: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

translations.meaning: 使符合；使一致；调节；授予，赠与，给予

example.en: The punishments accorded with the current code of discipline.
example.cn: 处罚与现行的纪律规则一致。

example.en: I am in accordance with him in this matter.
example.cn: 在这件事情上我同他是一致的。

example.en: Some of the laws were contradictory. Accordingly, measures were taken to clarify them.
example.cn: 有些法律相互矛盾，因此，采取了措施将其阐明。

example.en: My salary is paid into my bank account.
example.cn: 我的工资直接存入我的银行账户。

example.en: He is studying accountancy or he is an accountancy student.
example.cn: 他正在学习会计学或他是一名会计专业的学生。

example.en: Do you want me to invite your accountant to this meeting?
example.cn: 你想让我把你的会计师也邀请到会议里么？

example.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
example.cn: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

example.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
example.cn: 他传球准确无误。

example.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
example.cn: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

example.en: The main accusation levelled against him was that he tried to avoid military service.
example.cn: 对他提出的主要指控是他想逃避兵役。

example.en: The professor stands accused of (= has been accused of ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
example.cn: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

example.en: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
example.cn: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

example.en: The pans were in their accustomed places.
example.cn: 那些锅在老地方。

example.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
example.cn: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

example.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
example.cn: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

example.en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
example.cn: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

example.en: a juicy apple with a slightly acid flavour
example.cn: 一个多汁、略带酸味的苹果

translations.meaning: 承认， 承认…的权威； 告知收到， 确认； 对…表示感谢， 报偿

example.en: The family acknowledge the need for change.
example.cn: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

example.en: Have steps been taken to acquaint breeders with their right to apply for licenses?
example.cn: 已经采取措施让饲养动物者了解他们申请执照的权利了吗？

example.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
example.cn: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

example.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
example.cn: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

translations.meaning: 取得， 获得， 习得； 获得物， 增添的人

example.en: the acquisition of language
example.cn: 语言的习得

example.en: They own 200 acres of farmland.
example.cn: 他们拥有200英亩农田。

example.en: He walked across the field.
example.cn: 他走过田地。

example.en: The company acted correctly in sacking him.
example.cn: 公司解雇他做得对。

example.en: The government must take action (= do something ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
example.cn: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

example.en: games for active youngsters
example.cn: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

example.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
example.cn: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

example.en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
example.cn: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

example.en: She's not only a great dramatic actress but she's also very funny.
example.cn: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

example.en: I’m not joking. Those were his actual words.
example.cn: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

example.en: I’ve known Barbara for years. Since we were babies, actually.
example.cn: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了，实际上我们从小就认识。

example.en: Young children have a particularly acute sense of smell.
example.cn: 幼儿的嗅觉特别灵敏。

example.en: She replied to a lonely hearts ad she spotted in the New York Times.
example.cn: 她回复了在《纽约时报》上看到的一则求友广告。

example.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
example.cn: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

example.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
example.cn: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

example.en: She helped him fight his drug addiction.
example.cn: 她帮助了他对抗自己的毒瘾。

example.en: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
example.cn: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

example.en: Additional information can be obtained from the centre.
example.cn: 可以从中心获取更多信息。

example.en: The address is 2025 M Street, NW, Washington, DC, 20036.
example.cn: 地址是华盛顿哥伦比亚特区，华盛顿西北，M街2025号，邮编20036。

example.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
example.cn: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

example.en: In “the black cat” the adjective “black”modifies the noun “cat”.
example.cn: 在“那只黑猫”中，形容词“黑的”修饰名词“猫”。

example.en: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
example.cn: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

example.en: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
example.cn: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

example.en: The job is mainly administrative.
example.cn: 这份工作主要是行政方面的。

example.en: Daniel gazed at her in admiration .
example.cn: 丹尼尔用爱慕的眼神注视着她。

example.en: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
example.cn: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

example.en: Reese, by his own admission , lacks the necessary experience.
example.cn: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

example.en: ‘Okay, so maybe I was a little bit scared,’ Jenny admitted.
example.cn: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

example.en: Sally was adopted when she was four.
example.cn: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

translations.meaning: 收养关系的； 采用的

example.en: He was brought up by adoptive parents in Kentucky.
example.cn: 他是被他在肯塔基州的养父母抚养大的。

example.en: Some children find it difficult to talk to adults.
example.cn: 一些孩子觉得与大人很难谈得来。

example.en: A line of US tanks slowly advanced.
example.cn: 一列美军坦克缓缓前进。

example.en: advanced weapon systems
example.cn: 先进的武器系统

example.en: career advancement
example.cn: 职业发展

example.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (= have an advantage ) when applying for jobs.
example.cn: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

example.en: Come on – where’s your sense of adventure?
example.cn: 来吧——你的冒险精神哪里去了？

example.en: Will you please compare the adverb “well”?
example.cn: 请你说出副词“well”的原级、比较级和最高级好吗?

example.en: his courage in the face of adversity
example.cn: 他面对逆境的勇气

translations.meaning: 为…做广告， 宣传； 公告； 登广告

example.en: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
example.cn: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

example.en: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News’, offering a high salary for the right person.
example.cn: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

example.en: You should have followed my advice.
example.cn: 你真该听我的建议。

example.en: I deem it advisable to buy property now.
example.cn: 我认为现在购置房地产是明智的。

example.en: She needed someone to advise her.
example.cn: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

example.en: The State Department issues travel advisories about conditions overseas.
example.cn: 国务院就海外局势发布旅游警报。

translations.meaning: 拥护， 提倡， 主张
拥护者， 提倡者； 辩护者， 律师

example.en: Extremists were openly advocating violence.
example.cn: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

example.en: The aeroplane landed us at the airport in Barcelona.
example.cn: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

example.en: Are you interested in world affairs?
example.cn: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

example.en: the areas affected by the hurricane
example.cn: 受飓风影响的地区

example.en: She looked back on those days with affection .
example.cn: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

example.en: an affectionate hug
example.cn: 亲切的拥抱

example.en: The general affirmed rumors of an attack.
example.cn: 将军证实了袭击的传闻。

example.en: On the other hand, when he/she is being positive, reply in affirmation and enthusiasm.
example.cn: 另一方面，当他处于积极状态时，要用肯定和热情的话语来答复。

example.en: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
example.cn: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

example.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
example.cn: 没有必要害怕。

example.en: The giraffe ranges in Africa.
example.cn: 长颈鹿生长在非洲。

example.en: ...the African continent.
example.cn: …非洲大陆。

example.en: After the war many soldiers stayed in France.
example.cn: 战后，许多士兵留在法国。

example.en: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
example.cn: 星期四下午有个会议。

example.en: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
example.cn: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

example.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
example.cn: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

example.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
example.cn: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

example.en: Francis is the same age as me.
example.cn: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

example.en: a UN agency responsible for helping refugees
example.cn: 负责为难民提供帮助的联合国机构

example.en: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
example.cn: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

example.en: Our agent in Rio deals with all our Brazilian business.
example.cn: 我们在里约热内卢的业务代表处理我们在巴西的全部业务。

example.en: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
example.cn: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

example.en: They moved to a new house some time ago (= a fairly long time ago ) .
example.cn: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

example.en: the agony of arthritis
example.cn: 关节炎的剧烈疼痛

example.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
example.cn: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

example.en: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
example.cn: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

example.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.
example.cn: 75%以上的土地用于农耕。

example.en: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
example.cn: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

example.en: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
example.cn: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

example.en: Denver aimed his gun but did not shoot.
example.cn: 丹佛举枪瞄准，但是没有射击。

example.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
example.cn: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

example.en: The return flight of the aircraft was delayed.
example.cn: 飞机的返回航程被推迟了。

example.en: an airline pilot
example.cn: 航空公司飞行员

example.en: The airplane cracked up in landing.
example.cn: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

example.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
example.cn: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

example.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
example.cn: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

example.en: a photograph album
example.cn: 相册

example.en: I don’t drink alcohol anymore.
example.cn: 我不再喝酒了。

translations.meaning: 警戒， 戒备； 警报

example.en: The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
example.cn: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

translations.meaning: 一样地， 相似地； 同样程度地

example.en: The twins were dressed alike.
example.cn: 这对双胞胎穿着相似。

example.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
example.cn: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

example.en: There is built-in storage space in all bedrooms.
example.cn: 所有卧室里都有内置储藏空间。

example.en: independent organizations and alliances
example.cn: 独立组织和联盟

translations.meaning: 分配， 分派， 把…拨给

example.en: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
example.cn: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

example.en: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
example.cn: 泳池内禁止跳水。

translations.meaning: 津贴， 补贴； 零用钱

example.en: Sales staff get a generous mileage allowance or a company car.
example.cn: 销售人员有优厚的里程补贴或者公司提供的专用汽车。

example.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
example.cn: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

translations.meaning: 同盟国， 同盟者； 支持者

example.en: He will have no choice but to ally himself with the new movement.
example.cn: 他将别无选择，只能与这个新运动结盟。

example.en: Have you almost finished?
example.cn: 你差不多完成了吗？

example.en: She lives alone .
example.cn: 她一个人生活。

example.en: We were driving along Follyfoot Road.
example.cn: 我们沿着福莱福特路行驶。

translations.meaning: 在…旁边， 沿着…的边； 和…在一起

example.en: A car drew up alongside .
example.cn: 一辆车在旁边停了下来。

example.en: When we were children, our father read aloud to us.
example.cn: 当我们是孩子时，我们的父亲大声地朗读给我们听。

example.en: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
example.cn: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

example.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
example.cn: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

example.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
example.cn: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

example.en: Her face hadn’t altered much over the years.
example.cn: 过了这么多年，她的容貌并没有多大改变。

translations.meaning: 两者选一的， 供选择的； 另类的
替换物，选择；选择的自由

example.en: An alternative route is along the Via Unione.
example.cn: 另一条路线是沿着联合路走。

example.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
example.cn: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

example.en: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
example.cn: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

example.en: an old custom that has vanished altogether
example.cn: 一个彻底消亡的古老习俗

example.en: recycled aluminium cans
example.cn: 再生铝罐

example.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
example.cn: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

translations.meaning: 业余爱好的， 业余的； 外行的

example.en: ...professional athletes and amateur runners.
example.cn: …专业运动员和业余赛跑运动员。

example.en: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
example.cn: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

translations.meaning: 大使， 使节， 派驻国际组织的代表

example.en: ...the German ambassador to Poland.
example.cn: …德国驻波兰大使。

example.en: He was young and full of ambition.
example.cn: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

example.en: Alfred was intensely ambitious, obsessed with the idea of becoming rich.
example.cn: 艾尔弗雷德雄心勃勃，一心想着发财。

example.en: the ambulance service
example.cn: 救护车服务

example.en: I may go to America or I may not,it all depends.
example.cn: 我也许去美国，也许不去，要视情况而定。

example.en: Her mother is American.
example.cn: 她妈妈是美国人。

translations.meaning: 在…中间， 在…之中， 被…围绕

example.en: He sat amid the trees.
example.cn: 他坐在树丛中。

example.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
example.cn: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

example.en: Here in Trinity it is right that I should give you an account of how he lived amongst you during these years of his greatest achievement.
example.cn: 正是在三一学院这儿，我将对你们阐述他如何在你们中间生活，如何在这些年中取得他的最伟大的成就。

example.en: Please pay the full amount (= of money ) by the end of the month.
example.cn: 请在月底前全额付清。

example.en: an amplified guitar
